item.text:
Small-shop order utilities: totals item prices × quantities, applies coupon discounts, computes an average, and formats an order receipt.

Bugs:

- [test/orders.js:5](C:\Users\Kerim\AppData\Local\Temp\codex-eco-bench-qxBr6w\test\orders.js:5): `i <= items.length` accesses `items[items.length]`, causing a `TypeError`; use `i < items.length`.
- [test/orders.js:22](C:\Users\Kerim\AppData\Local\Temp\codex-eco-bench-qxBr6w\test\orders.js:22): `averageItemPrice` divides the order total by item count, not total quantity—its name is ambiguous; for per-unit average, divide by summed `qty`. It also returns `NaN` for an empty list.
